decks.notes: The deck revolves around assembling a powerful combo using Old Stickfingers as the commander. The key strategy involves utilizing various spells and enchantments to fill up the graveyard and then reanimating key creatures like Phyrexian Devourer or Walking Ballista to create a lethal threat. The deck includes a mix of tutors, discard spells, and removal to control the game while setting up the combo. It also includes ramp spells like Nature's Lore and Lotus Bloom to accelerate the mana development. The goal is to execute the combo as quickly and efficiently as possible, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan.

The deck revolves around using Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the commander to control the board with a diverse array of spells and creatures. The key concept is to utilize a wide range of removal, counter spells, and card advantage in order to outvalue and outmaneuver opponents. The deck includes versatile multicolored cards to ensure that Niv-Mizzet Reborn's ability to draw cards is consistently activated, allowing for greater flexibility and options in each game. By effectively managing resources and making strategic decisions, the deck aims to disrupt opponents' game plans while steadily building its own advantage until it can secure a win condition.

The deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay utilizing Minsc, Beloved Ranger as the commander. The key strategy involves ramping up mana quickly with mana dorks and mana acceleration spells to bring out powerful creatures like Kiki-Jiki, Mirror Breaker and Boonweaver Giant. The deck also includes various toolbox creatures that can be searched for with Birthing Pod or Green Sun's Zenith to deal with different situations. Protection is also crucial with cards like Mother of Runes and Giver of Runes to keep important creatures safe. The goal is to overwhelm the opponent with a consistent stream of threats and maintain board control to secure a victory.

The deck revolves around utilizing powerful graveyard recursion and reanimation strategies to bring back key combo pieces and game-winning creatures. It focuses on quickly assembling combo pieces in the graveyard with cards like Buried Alive and Final Parting, and then using spells like Reanimate and Animate Dead to put them into play. The deck also includes a variety of versatile removal spells and disruption to control the game until it can assemble its combo. The commander, Old Rutstein, provides additional graveyard synergy and card advantage to help facilitate the combo game plan. Overall, the deck aims to quickly assemble its combo pieces and overwhelm the opponent with powerful threats from the graveyard.

This deck focuses on using powerful reanimation spells like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring back high-impact creatures such as Emrakul, the Promised End and Griselbrand from the graveyard. It also includes various ways to discard creatures to set up for reanimation, such as Faithless Looting and Thrill of Possibility. The deck aims to control the board with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Fatal Push while setting up a game-winning combo with cards like Sneak Attack and Dark Ritual. In addition to the combo pieces, the deck also includes a selection of mana rocks and lands to ensure the resources needed to execute the combo are available.

Utilize aggressive and efficient creatures, burn spells, and land disruption to quickly reduce your opponent's life total and maintain control of the battlefield. Utilize cards like Lightning Bolt, Goblin Guide, and Monastery Swiftspear to apply early pressure, while utilizing cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon to disrupt your opponent's mana base. Use direct damage spells like Fireblast and Searing Blaze to finish off your opponent once they are within range. Feldon, Ronom Excavator provides graveyard recursion for additional value. The goal is to overwhelm your opponent with a combination of fast creatures and burn spells, preventing them from stabilizing or executing their own game plan.

The deck focuses on using a wide variety of powerful control cards to disrupt the opponent's strategy and protect your own. With a mix of efficient removal spells, versatile counterspells, and powerful planeswalkers, the deck aims to control the game and outvalue the opponent. The inclusion of Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the commander allows for card advantage and selection, ensuring that you have access to the right answers at the right time. The mana base is carefully constructed to support the deck's diverse color requirements, allowing for maximum flexibility in casting spells. Overall, the key concept of this deck is to establish control over the game through careful resource management and strategic decision-making.

The deck focuses on aggressive gameplay with a combination of white, red, and green cards to overwhelm the opponent in a 1 vs 1 Duel Commander format. The commanders, Yoshimaru and Tana, allow for flexibility and synergy in utilizing combat strategies and generating token creatures. The deck includes powerful creatures like Anafenza and Arni Brokenbrow, along with efficient removal spells like Lightning Bolt and Swords to Plowshares to maintain control of the battlefield. Additionally, key cards like Blood Moon and Boseiju, along with a diverse land base, provide disruption and mana advantage. Overall, the deck aims to quickly build a board presence and apply pressure to the opponent, ultimately achieving victory through aggressive tactics.

The central focus of this deck is to utilize the commander, Dihada, Binder of Wills, in order to assemble powerful combos and synergies that can disrupt the opponent's strategy and win the game. The deck includes a variety of powerful reanimation spells, such as Animate Dead and Reanimate, to bring back key creatures like Elesh Norn and Griselbrand. It also features a wide range of removal spells like Fatal Push and Swords to Plowshares to control the board and protect your own game plan. Additionally, the deck includes tutor effects like Demonic Tutor and Profane Tutor to find key pieces and maintain consistency in executing its combo strategy.

The focus of this deck is to utilize Dihada, Binder of Wills as the commander to enable powerful combo plays. The deck includes a variety of cards that can reanimate creatures from the graveyard, such as Animate Dead, Dance of the Dead, and Reanimate, allowing for explosive plays with high impact creatures like Griselbrand and Emrakul, the Promised End. The deck also includes cards like Demonic Tutor and Profane Tutor to search for combo pieces efficiently. With a mix of control elements like Duress and Thoughtseize, as well as removal like Fatal Push and Swords to Plowshares, the deck aims to disrupt opponents while assembling its combo pieces for a game-winning turn.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay, utilizing a variety of low cost creatures and burn spells to pressure the opponent and deal damage quickly. The commander, Feldon, Ronom Excavator, allows for repeated creature recursion to maintain board presence and apply constant pressure. The deck includes a mix of direct damage spells, efficient creatures, and cards that prevent opponents from stabilizing, such as Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon. By consistently applying pressure and utilizing burn spells to finish off opponents, this deck aims to win the game before the opponent can establish a strong defense or mount a comeback.

The focus of this aggressive Grist, The Hunger Tide deck is to generate value through sacrificing and recurring creatures while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with removal and hand disruption spells. By utilizing cards like Demonic Tutor, Survival of the Fittest, and Birthing Pod, the deck can tutor for key pieces and continuously bring threats onto the battlefield. With a mix of mana dorks and efficient creatures like Vengevine and Hogaak, Arisen Necropolis, the deck can quickly apply pressure and overwhelm opponents. Additionally, the deck has access to powerful spells like Toxic Deluge and Abrupt Decay to deal with opposing threats, making it a versatile and aggressive deck in the Duel Commander format.

The deck revolves around utilizing Leovold, Emissary of Trest's abilities to control the game by denying opponents resources and drawing cards. It contains a wide array of counterspells, removal spells, and disruptive cards to keep the opponent's game plan in check. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy while gradually building up its own resources. Cards like Hullbreacher, Narset, Parter of Veils, and Notion Thief are included to punish opponents for drawing cards. The deck also includes powerful planeswalkers like Jace, the Mind Sculptor and Oko, Thief of Crowns to generate value and control the board. It aims to outvalue and outcontrol the opponent to secure victory.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game by utilizing a wide range of removal spells, powerful creatures, and disruptive cards to outvalue and outmaneuver the opponent. The deck aims to maintain a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's game plan through counterspells, discard effects, and targeted removal. With Niv-Mizzet Reborn as the commander, the deck can generate card advantage and access a variety of powerful spells from different colors. By carefully managing resources and constantly applying pressure on the opponent, this control deck seeks to gradually take over the game and secure victory through card advantage and overwhelming board presence.

The deck focuses on using a combination of control spells and disruptive creatures to slow down the opponent's game plan, while also applying pressure through evasive threats and efficient removal spells. Raffine, Scheming Seer serves as the commander, providing card advantage and flexibility in different situations. The deck includes a mix of powerful creatures like True-Name Nemesis and Skyclave Apparition, along with disruptive cards such as Drannith Magistrate and Opposition Agent. It aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy, control the board, and maintain a steady stream of threats to pressure the opponent. Overall, the deck seeks to outmaneuver the opponent and win through a combination of attrition and aggression.

This deck focuses on utilizing a wide array of enchantments to control the board and disrupt the opponent's strategy. By leveraging cards like Enchantress's Presence, Eidolon of Blossoms, and Sythis, Harvest's Hand to draw cards, the deck aims to maintain card advantage while continuing to deploy enchantments. Sythis, Harvest's Hand serves as a key piece in this strategy, providing a steady stream of card draw and life gain. With cards like Greater Auramancy and Sterling Grove to protect against removal, and powerful enchantments like Solitary Confinement and Parallax Wave to control the battlefield, the deck aims to outvalue and outlast opponents until it can secure a win condition, whether through combat damage or a combo finish.
